name: TCL 65C7K
summary: TCL 65C7K QD-Mini LED ships with a Samba TV viewing tracker and TCL promos. TidyTV is a free phone app that turns them off, with a backup and one-tap undo.
intro: This Brazilian TCL runs Google TV on Android 14. It ships with Samba TV, which tracks what is on screen, TCL analytics, log upload and account sign-in nags. It also has TCL Live FAST channels, content pushed to the home screen at boot, push messages and promos, retail demo and hotel mode apps, and a cleaner.

The list was applied and verified on a real unit on the same day: HDMI switching, broadcast TV and the new home screen worked over Wi-Fi. Chromecast was not tested yet. TidyTV saves a backup first, never deletes anything and lets you switch any app back on.
keep: Live TV and HDMI (the TCL TV app)
Ginga, the Brazilian broadcast TV software
The keyboard and the remote service
The ambient screensaver, which the owner likes
notes: Wireless debugging switches on only over Wi-Fi. On Ethernet the toggle flips back off, so use Wi-Fi when pairing.
Wi-Fi saved during first setup may belong to the setup app. Forget and rejoin it in Settings first.

faq.q: Will the voice button still work on my TCL 65C7K?
faq.a: Not with the default list, which turns off Google Assistant voice by the owner's choice. Switch it back on in the app if you use it.
Yes. Ginga, the Brazilian broadcast TV software, is kept, and it was checked.

faq.q: Will it stop the ads on the home screen?
faq.a: It turns off the TCL Live FAST channels, content pushed at boot, TCL tweaks to the home rows and the push messages and promos.
